Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.util

Class ConditionalActionWrapper

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.util.ConditionalActionWrapper
@Component public class ConditionalActionWrapper extends Object
Spring-friendly wrapper around ConditionalActionChain that simplifies conditional action execution in Brobot applications.

This wrapper provides:

  • Convenient methods for common patterns
  • Integration with StateObject types
  • Pre-configured action builders
  • Simplified error handling

Example usage: 


 @Autowired
 private ConditionalActionWrapper actions;

 // Simple find and click
 ActionResult result = actions.findAndClick(submitButton);

 // Using the chain builder
 ActionResult result = actions.createChain()
         .find(searchField)
         .ifFound(click())
         .ifFound(type("search query"))
         .execute();
